description: Boolean status flag stored as string with inconsistent textual representations across 30 records (no missing values). Contains 6 distinct values representing binary true/false states using multiple formats: 'True'/'False', '1'/'0', and 'yes'/'no'.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Unify boolean representations: convert '1' → 'True', 'yes' → 'True', '0' → 'False', 'no' → 'False', then convert to intended boolean type.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to strict boolean format (True/False) after standardization.
